-- REQ: LANG-2011 LANG-2012 LANG-2013 LANG-2014 /* Word count */ lines = LOAD 'input.txt' USING PigStorage('\t') AS (line:chararray); words = FOREACH lines GENERATE FLATTEN(TOKENIZE(line)) AS word; grouped = GROUP words BY word; counts = FOREACH grouped GENERATE group, COUNT(words) AS n; big = FILTER counts BY n > 10 AND word IS NOT NULL; STORE big INTO 'out' USING PigStorage(',');
